author: Samir_Lakers
quote:
Congratulations to Rockstar for spending over a decade and billions of dollars to finally answer the question nobody asked: "What if Grand Theft Auto was a slow-paced relationship drama mixed with a minimum-wage part-time job?"

Honestly, the 24 FPS gunfights really elevate the whole "cinematic" experience. Nothing screams next-gen crime spree quite like watching your screen turn into a PowerPoint presentation the exact second a police helicopter shows up. And let’s not forget the launch-day bugs—watching NPCs clip through the floor while you're stuck in a five-second animation just to pick up a single wrench really keeps you immersed in the gritty realism.
Speaking of realism, thank goodness Rockstar decided that carrying more than two guns at a time was ruining the sanctity **** where you can survive getting hit by a rocket. Walking back to your car trunk every ten minutes to swap out a shotgun is peak gameplay. Even better is when the main story grinds to a screeching halt so you can go do chores and grind cash like you’re trying to pay off a real-life mortgage. Who needs chaotic sandbox fun when you can run digital errands?

At least Vice City looks gorgeous while you're bored out of your mind. Sure, the moment you drive ten minutes outside the neon lights you're greeted by vast, empty stretches of nothing, and the story has about as much sharp satire as a daytime soap opera but hey, the water physics are incredible! 10/10 realistic tedium simulator. Can't wait to buy the remastered version in 2032 just to get 60 frames per second.
